I am young, only 21, and this rice plot is small — just 0.16 hectares. Rice needs water, so I planted it in a dambo area where the ground stays wet during the rains. I hope to get a FISP coupon for fertilizer; if I do, I will put some urea on the rice because it helps the grain fill well. I cannot afford pesticides, and I will use seed saved from last season or shared from neighbors. My family will do most of the work ourselves — me, and help from my parents and siblings — but at transplanting and harvest I may need to hire a few people for one or two days.
